title: rosa biserrata f. oenensis
intro: Rosa biserrata f. oenensis, commonly known as the Oenothera rosea or Evening Primrose, is a flowering plant species within the Onagraceae family. It is known for its numerous health benefits, including reducing inflammation, improving heart health, and supporting mental well-being due to its high levels of essential fatty acids and antioxidants. The therapeutic actions of Rosa biserrata f. oenensis include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which can help to soothe skin irritations, promote wound healing, and protect against cell damage. The bioactive constituents of this plant include gamma-linolenic acid (GLA), linoleic acid, and other polyunsaturated fatty acids, which contribute to its therapeutic effects.
